title: PostgreSQL DROP OWNED can remove restrictive row security policies from non-owned tables (CVE-2026-116311)
description: A missing authorization vulnerability in PostgreSQL's DROP OWNED command allows a role to remove itself from restrictive row-level security policies on tables it does not own. This enables the role to read or modify rows that the policies were intended to restrict. The issue affects PostgreSQL versions prior to 14.25, 15.20, 16.16, 17.12, and 18.7.
